title: HOMEDOME Open Energy Data (Ukraine): day-ahead market spread index, distribution tariffs by region, solar generation
description:
Open data behind HOMEDOME's solar and battery payback calculations for Ukraine, mirrored weekly from homedome.com.ua.

  • Day-ahead market (DAM) spread index: daily max − min hourly price and net spread after transmission and distribution tariffs and 15% round-trip losses, since 2025-01-01; derived from hourly results published by Market Operator JSC (oree.com.ua).
  • Distribution tariffs of 22 Ukrainian DSOs (voltage classes 1 and 2) and the transmission tariff, UAH/MWh, with NEURC resolution numbers.
  • BESS arbitrage model by region (model output, not measurements): net spread, cycles per year, revenue and payback of a 125 kW / 261 kWh cabinet.
  • Solar generation: measured monthly output of a 10 kW station in Dnipro region and an estimated specific yield by city (kWh/kWp/year).

Відкриті дані HOMEDOME про енергетику України: індекс спредів РДН, тарифи на розподіл за регіонами, модель арбітражу накопичувачів, генерація сонячних станцій.
